finding: Benchmark (open, navigate, eval through the CLI against the same Chromium, then the daemon's own memory): wall 1657 ms with the Node daemon vs 370 ms with the Rust one; daemon resident set 184.5 MB vs 4.8 MB (about 38 times smaller).
